PostToolUse.description: Opt-in: after any write to src/**, run scoped impacted tests. Branch-gated to autorun/* only. Cost-cap-aware: respects config.cost.maxUsd and skips when budget at 90%.

_meta.note: Disabled by default. Enable per project by setting enabled=true AND config.tddLoop.postEditTests=true. The runner script lives at .github/scripts/post-edit-run-tests.js and is generated by Phase E (T-E2) CI workflow authoring.
_meta.exitCodeContract: 0 = ok; 20+N = regression; 40 = cost cap; 31 = article X violation.
